name: Woodcutter's Pair (Tiều Phu Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: once a fight, a hit that would drop you leaves you standing at 1 health with your body shield full; your next axe hit within 3 s heals you for half its damage.

story: His father's axe and his mother's vest. Tuần Tùng Đường offered him a sword for the axe; he has not answered.

name: The Digger's Kit (Quật Phu Tam Cụ)

bonuses.rule: the Lamp's flame also leans toward the way out in a fight. Once a fight, below a third of your health, you may leave at once; while you stand inside a foe's array, each of your seal hits breaks one of its nodes.

story: Lamp, seal and coat of the boss of the ruin-diggers, gathered over eighty years of dead halls. She means to leave them to whoever outlives her on the coast.

name: Bobtail Chief's Gear (Đoản Vĩ Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Never Had a Healer (Vô Y Giả)
bonuses.rule: health your leech would waste on full health becomes a body shield instead, and the shield loses a tenth of itself each second; while that shield holds, your axe crits deal 25 % more damage.

story: One lynx made the axe and the armour; the ring came with the band. Whole since 1150; Triều Ngũ Lang knows where Khấu would leave them.

name: Thaw-Girl's Fire (Giải Băng Song Hỏa)

bonuses.rule: your fist hits lay one Fire stack, and two on a foe that carries Ice stacks or is slowed.

story: The brazier Phàn Cổ Đăng bought her in 1195 and the coal the lamp-boss sealed from it a year later. A Luyện Khí wears one thing, so the pendant waits on a cord in her pack until her Trúc Cơ.
